Product Inquiry
WHY YASH

Made in India. Trusted Worldwide. 

We have a strong track record of providing world-class transformer bushings across the globe for two decades. We deliver quality solutions that cater to the specific needs of Industries, Utilities, and provide best value proposition to our stakeholders. 

Learn More

01

Quality

Yash® products have received a seal of reliability and approval from discerning National Utilities and across all State and Private Power Transmission and Generation Utilities of the country. 

02

Lead Time

Our advanced planning, supply chain and inventory management systems are designed to deliver industry-best lead times. Partnering with top logistics partners, we guarantee timely delivery to even the most remote locations by sea, air, or road. 

03

Response Time

Our rapid response time ensures your needs are met with speed and precision.

ABOUT US

Powered by Innovation,
Led by Conviction 

Yash Highvoltage, ISO 9001:2015 certified and listed on BSE SME, was founded with a focus on quality and precision, and has grown into a trusted name in the advanced transformer bushing solutions industry.

​

With 45,000+ installations powering progress across the globe, Yash® stands as a preferred partner to the upper segment of the power transformer industry – from generation to transmission – across India and the world.

 

With state-of-the-art manufacturing and testing facilities, and a team driven by expertise and innovation, Yash® delivers world-class, future-ready solutions that don’t just meet industry needs but set new benchmarks for performance and reliability.

OUR PRODUCT

Powering the Future 

Yash® delivers a high-performance range of OIP, RIP, and RIS transformer bushings, driven by industry-leading expertise, a forward-thinking strategy, and robust research and innovation – ensuring the highest reliability of these critically engineered components. 

OIP Condenser Bushings 

Most widely used bushing type in the high-voltage transmission industry worldwide, our OIP condenser bushings are designed to meet varying voltage and current requirements, with flexible insulator options, viz. porcelain and silicone, adhering to IEC, IEEE, and other international standards, are tailored to support the evolving needs of the global power industry. 

​

Learn More

High Current Bushing 

Expertly engineered to deliver superior performance in generation transformer applications across India and globally, our high current bushings withstand even the most demanding conditions. Available in voltage classes from 24 kV to 52 kV and current ratings from 4000 A to 25000 A, they are designed to meet all major international standards, including IEC-60137:2017, IEEE C.57.19.00/01, and their equivalents. 

Learn More

RIP/RIS Condenser Bushings

Designed for modern power systems, our RIP/RIS bushings ensure long-term durability and efficiency, making them the ideal choice for high-performance, low-maintenance operations. Engineered with resin-impregnated crepe paper or synthetic insulation, these bushings are leakage-free, non-flammable, have excellent thermal and electrical performance amongst having many other advantages that leads to superior reliability and environmental sustainability.  

Learn More

OIP Wall Bushings/Oil to Oil Bushings 

We provide a comprehensive range of Oil-Impregnated Paper (OIP) bushings, expertly designed for wall-through applications and oil-oil installations within transformer cable boxes. With extensive customization options tailored to specific customer requirements, these specialized solutions of ours are performing successfully for a diverse clientele across India and worldwide. 

Learn More

Retrofit Solutions 

Seamless Upgrades for
Your Transformer Bushings

With a proven track record in large-scale supply adhering to IEC, IEEE, and other international design standards, we have also pioneered blanket interchangeable solutions for OIP-to-OIP, OIP-to-RIP, and OIP-to-RIS transformer bushings. These innovations are designed to extend transformer service life while ensuring seamless integration and operational efficiency. 

Learn More

Retrofit Consultation

Customization

Site Visit

Innovate & Excel 

Build Your Future with Yash Highvoltage

Join a team of experts shaping the future of power infrastructure. At Yash®, we offer dynamic career opportunities in engineering, R&D, business development, operations, and many more fields, fostering innovation and professional growth. 

Learn More

Services & Consulting 

Diagnosis & Optimization  

At Yash®, we offer a full suite of services for any globally reputed make of transformer bushings that provide reliability, extended asset life, and minimal operational disruption for power utilities and OEMs alike. 

Learn More

Service Consultation

Engineering consultation by experienced service engineers with customer’s technical team to evaluate existing products and drawings and arrive at suitable repairing solutions.

Condition Assessment

On-site and off-site capacitance and tan δ test services for condition monitoring of transformer bushings, early fault detection with the help of state-of-the-art portable test kit and spot recommendations by experts. 

Repairing Services

Specialised repairing solutions for damage to transformer bushings caused during handling, transportation, storage, erection, etc. 

Smart Replacements

Overhaul and/or part replacement of transformer bushings of any global make.
